The game looked destined for a draw until a moment of brilliance in the 84th minute. Guela Doue , turning from scorer to creator, provided the assist for Amad Diallo , who powered home a right-footed strike to put Ivory Coast ahead for the first time. Late Drama and Final Stand In the dying minutes, France threw everything forward in search of an equalizer. Lucas Digne and Maghnes Akliouche swung in several corners, but the delivery failed to find a teammate in the crowded penalty area. Despite five minutes of added time and a late offside call against Ange-Yoan Bonny , Ivory Coast managed to weather the storm. The referee's final whistle confirmed a hard-fought victory for the visitors, who capitalized on their chances to stun the French side despite having only 41% of the ball possession.
